title: Local or advected: subsurface anomalies of 2014-2016
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity, velocity, sea surface height and mixed-layer thickness for 2011-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), determine whether the subsurface temperature and salinity anomalies during 2014-2016 were produced locally or advected into the region, and through which pathways.
